title: Cherednik integrable system: eigenfunctions at generic eigenvalues
summary: Symmetric Macdonald polynomials of $N$ variables provide eigenfunctions of the $N$-body trigonometric Ruijsenaars-Schneider integrable system at particular eigenvalues. In order to construct eigenfunctions with arbitrary eigenvalues, M. Noumi and J. Shiraishi used a recursion in $N$ (branching rule) for the symmetric Macdonald polynomials and analytically continued them. This generated a power series, which is a part of triad (universal solution). In the present paper, we demonstrate that a similar procedure is available for another integrable system, $N$-body Cherednik integrable system…
